rows.question: Find all photometrically observable star that have spectral observations. Retrieve the object id, right ascension, and declination.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH spec_matches AS (
  -- collect specobj rows that correspond to a photoobj either via bestobjid
  -- or via specobjid that is present in galspecline or spplines
  SELECT s.specobjid, s.bestobjid
  FROM specobj s
  WHERE s.bestobjid IS NOT NULL
     OR s.specobjid IN (SELECT specobjid FROM galspecline)
     OR s.specobjid IN (SELECT specobjid FROM spplines)
)
SELECT p.objid AS object_id,
       p.ra    AS right_ascension,
       p.dec   AS declination
FROM photoobj p
JOIN spec_matches sm
  ON p.objid = sm.bestobjid
     OR p.objid = sm.specobjid
WHERE p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
  AND p.type = 6

  LEFT JOIN photoobj_star_cohort_3 AS s3 USING (objid)
